question.text: Consider all the structural isomers with molecular formula $\mathrm{C}_{5} \mathrm{H}_{11} \mathrm{Br}$ are separately treated with $\mathrm{KOH}(\mathrm{aq})$ to give respective substitution products, without any rearrangement. The number of products which can exhibit optical isomerism from these is $\_\_\_\_$.
